biggest_catch: This is a host referral: your friend must own a car, list it on Turo, and actually complete 3 trips or 15 trip days with zero cancellations within 6 months before either of you earns a dollar.
catches: Your friend must complete 3 completed trips or 15 trip days (whichever comes first) within 6 months of submitting the referral form, with no cancellations.
Friend must be a new Turo host who signs up via your referral link and lists a vehicle.
The $300 bonus is added directly to your Turo earnings (the friend's $300 is also stated as earned to their Turo account).
The referrer must also have a Turo host referral setup (they need a referral link/form from their Turo account).
The separate $500 All-Star Host and $500 Power Host bonuses shown on the page are host-status earnings incentives, not part of the referral program.
No stated cap on the number of referrals is given on the page, and program details may change; 'Terms and conditions apply' is stated without a linked full terms document on this page.
